description: Seen from above, in a cosy bedroom at night, a young man in a white T-shirt and striped pyjama bottoms kneels in the middle of a bed and swings pillows left and right to push back laughing young women in pyjamas who reach for him from all sides. He hits out again and again as feathers burst into the air. Fairy lights lie on the bedspread, trays of croissants sit on the bed and the bedside table, an open suitcase spills clothes, and a dog sits at the foot of the bed.

taps.phrase: to sit calmly on the floor

de.answer: Er wehrt die Frauen mit einem Kissen ab.
